final_sql: SELECT s.Name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM hiring h JOIN shop s ON s.Shop_ID = h.Shop_ID GROUP BY s.Shop_ID, s.Name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5
answer:
**FC Haka** has the most employees. It has 2, and every other shop has 1 or fewer.

I counted employees from the `hiring` table, which links employees to shops. I counted each hiring record as one employee, whether full-time or part-time.

args.sql: SELECT s.Name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM hiring h JOIN shop s ON s.Shop_ID = h.Shop_ID GROUP BY s.Shop_ID, s.Name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5
